surface_request: Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
plan:
Join reports_root and filename, lexically normalize the result, and raise ValueError if the path is not strictly beneath reports_root. Check each path component from filename under reports_root; raise ValueError if any user-selected component is a symbolic link, even when that link currently points to a file inside reports_root. Open the target file, propagate FileNotFoundError if it is missing, read the full contents decoded as UTF-8, and return the text.
END_PLAN
